correctness.rationale: The second-difference matrix B is surjective by recurrence, so B_A has full row rank for every active set. Prescribe curvature zero on A and one off A to get x; y=x−B_Aᵀ1 has projection x by the KKT conditions with strictly positive active multipliers. Strict primal slack and strict multipliers persist locally, and the projection there is H_A=I−B_Aᵀ(B_AB_Aᵀ)⁻¹B_A. The first-difference map D has right inverse J given by cumulative step columns. Since H_A fixes constants, the active-cell quotient norm is the largest absolute column sum of DH_AJ. Integrating on line segments and using continuity gives the upper bound globally; perturbing an open-cell point by a maximizing step attains it. Appending an inactive constraint gives H_A⊕[1]; extending the step by its tail keeps the input TV and preserves all old output edges, proving monotonicity. On the affine face the slope for step j is covariation divided by site variance, 6j(n−j)/[n(n²−1)], giving the stated TV norm and limit. A separate exact Fraction implementation enumerated all 127 faces for n=2–8 and obtained 1, 1, 6/5, 4/3, 7/5, 28/19, 11/7. It verified finite witnesses at ε=1/100 with strict slack, positive multipliers and the exact quotient in each size. The n=7 alternate maximizer has A={2,3,5}, step 4 and column (−4,6,6,6,3,3)/19; it is the reflected witness and does not conflict with the frozen one.
residual_risks: Independent enumeration is exhaustive only through eight sites. All-dimensional conclusions rest on the face and embedding proofs. The prior-source verdict below does not dispute these mathematical results.

value.rationale: The exact first-expansion cutoff and finite classification would be useful if they were distinct, but repeating a table already reported through a larger size does not supply fresh scientific value. After setting those claims aside, the all-face formula is the induced ℓ¹ column norm of the standard affine pieces of a cone projector. Appending one coordinate with the new face constraint slack gives monotonicity directly from that identity. As submitted, that remainder does not resolve a further exact regime, limiting modulus, or structural obstruction beyond the routine face reduction and extension. No available remainder warrants a repaired claim.
residual_risks: This assessment does not devalue first-variation analysis of convex regression as a problem. It distinguishes a useful independent confirmation from a distinct scientific finding.
